text_block_list.orig_text:
いこう、
アイラさん！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Right with you, Knight-kun! We're gonna burn as hot as the blazing sun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははっ、
来たね騎士くん！
照りつける太陽みたいに、
燃え上がるよー！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
I'm pouring my very being into this single strike...!
SPIRESBANE BLADE... FLAME OF DAWN!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの全部、
この一撃に乗せて──！
天楼覇断剣・
明ノ焔！！
